name: Commonwealth Indigenous Accommodation and Education Costs Scholarships (SCU)
summary: Accommodation and education-cost scholarships for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander SCU students in financial hardship.
key: Accommodation: $8,000 per year for three years ($24,000). Education costs: $4,000 per year for three years ($12,000).
who: Any course or degree at SCU.
how: Complete the online application linked from the scholarship page.
catches: Can't be held alongside certain Centrelink or ISSP accommodation or education-cost payments.
Paid per term based on enrolled credit points.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Commonwealth Indigenous Scholarships

evidence.quote: Annual Full Time Value = $8,000 per year for three years or $24,000
Annual Full Time Value = $4,000 per year for three years or $12,000
Applicants must be experiencing financial hardship.
